# One contract, two languages, one meaning (#151).
# Every slot of the contracts example-java.xmi (m2t) and
# binding/example-ts.xmi both render, with the type each language gives
# it - the discipline of the sd1 golden fixtures, applied to the type
# mapping. test/type-pins.test.ts holds the generated TypeScript to it;
# the Java column is checked once the m2t side reads it too (#185).
# Rows of an operation are in parameter order; 'return' is the return
# slot, 'throws' a declared exception. optional: whether the slot may be
# left out (Java boxes it, TypeScript marks it '?').
